questions.question: On this day in 1471, the Swedish regent Sten Sture the Elder repelled an attack by which monarch?
questions.explanation: With support from local farmers and miners, Swedish regent Sten Sture successfully defended against King Christian I of Denmark.
questions.context:
On this day in 1471: Sten Sture the Elder, the Regent of Sweden, with the help of farmers and miners, repels an attack by King Christian I of Denmark.
Sten Sture the Elder (Regent of Sweden (r. 1470–1497; 1501–1503)): Sten Sture the Elder was a Swedish statesman and regent of Sweden from 1470 to 1497 and again from 1501 to 1503.

questions.question: Directed by Aaron Sorkin as a sequel to The Social Network, the 2026 film The Social Reckoning centres on a whistleblower leak from which company?
questions.explanation: The Social Reckoning dramatises the disclosure of confidential internal documents from Facebook by whistleblower Frances Haugen.
questions.context: The Social Reckoning (2026 film by Aaron Sorkin): The Social Reckoning is a 2026 American biographical legal thriller film written, co-produced, and directed by Aaron Sorkin. A sequel to The Social Network (2010), it dramatizes the 2021 Facebook leak by the whistleblower Frances Haugen and Jeff Horwitz. It stars Mikey Madison, Jeremy Allen White, Jeremy Strong, Bill Burr, Wunmi Mosaku, Betty Gilpin, and Billy Magnussen.

questions.question: Which English singer-songwriter achieved global fame with the hit singles 'You're Beautiful' and 'Goodbye My Lover'?
questions.explanation: James Blunt is an English musician celebrated for his chart-topping ballad 'You're Beautiful' as well as 'Goodbye My Lover'.
questions.context: James Blunt (English musician (born 1974)): James Blunt is an English singer, songwriter and musician. He is known for his songs "You're Beautiful" and "Goodbye My Lover".

questions.question: American photographer Ansel Adams, renowned for his black-and-white landscapes of the American West, co-founded which group promoting sharp focus and pure photography?
questions.explanation: Ansel Adams co-founded Group f/64, an association dedicated to unmanipulated photography that utilised sharp focus and complete tonal range.
questions.context: Ansel Adams (American photographer and environmentalist (1902–1984)): Ansel Easton Adams was an American landscape photographer and environmentalist known for his black-and-white images of the American West. He helped found Group f/64, an association of photographers advocating "pure" photography which favored sharp focus and the use of the full tonal range of a photograph.

questions.question: The horror television miniseries Carrie, developed by Mike Flanagan, is adapted from the 1974 debut novel by which author?
questions.explanation: The miniseries is based on Stephen King's 1974 novel Carrie, marking the story's fourth screen adaptation.
questions.context: Carrie (miniseries) (2026 miniseries by Mike Flanagan): Carrie is an American supernatural horror television miniseries developed by Mike Flanagan, and produced by Amazon MGM Studios for Amazon Prime Video. The first series adaptation of the eponymous franchise, it is based on the 1974 novel by Stephen King, and is the fourth screen adaptation of the novel.
